subject.title: Fix auth_profile_store not resyncing when apiKey is updated in openclaw.json

question: When a configured provider API key and its bound per-agent SQLite auth profile disagree, should configuration be authoritative at runtime, or should the stored profile remain authoritative until the user explicitly runs Doctor repair?
rationale: Both values can represent intentionally managed credentials, and the choice changes upgrade behavior and which credential model requests use; repository policy does not permit inferring that permanent contract from a one-sided repair.

options.title: Define an explicit Doctor migration contract
options.body: Keep stored profiles authoritative during normal runtime, but surface drift in a user-visible diagnostic and let `openclaw doctor --fix` reconcile only under a documented precedence rule.

options.title: Make configured API keys authoritative
options.body: Rework model credential resolution or startup reconciliation so a configured API key reliably wins, with focused upgrade coverage for existing stored profiles.

options.title: Pause for an auth-precedence decision
options.body: Do not merge a profile-overwriting repair until owners confirm the intended source of truth and the non-technical recovery path.

recommendation.title: Pause for an auth-precedence decision
recommendation.body: Do not merge a profile-overwriting repair until owners confirm the intended source of truth and the non-technical recovery path.

likelyOwner.reason: No dependable current-main feature-history owner could be identified from the supplied read-only evidence.
